prose:
A New York Times item summarized by Techmeme attributes to a court filing allegations that former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan recorded meetings and photographed a confidential term sheet. The excerpt mentions customers, AI safety and a foreign-government briefing.

The primary article returned an access error, and the filing, defense response and underlying recordings were not inspected. Allegations in a criminal proceeding are not adjudicated findings, and the presence of a foreign-government meeting does not by itself establish espionage or the identity of an intended recipient. The story is kept separate from a later Bloomberg account with its own access limits.
highlights: Claims are attributed to a court filing via NYT
Feed mentions meeting recordings and a term-sheet photograph
Primary article and filing were not inspected
No finding of guilt is established
A recorded foreign-government briefing is not proof of espionage
Underlying confidential material was not accessed
